style.vernacular: Timber city: Victorian and Edwardian villas and Californian bungalows in painted kauri weatherboard with verandahs and corrugated-iron roofs (some Marseilles tile), brick-and-roughcast 1920s-30s Tudor and Arts and Crafts houses, 1950s-60s concrete and glass modernist civic blocks, and glass-and-metal contemporary malls, hospitals and campuses. Volcanic cones, basalt dry-stone walls, pohutukawa, nikau and tree ferns.
style.ornament: Villa verandahs with cast-iron or timber fretwork and bay windows; Californian bungalow gables and tapered porch piers; Tudor-revival half-timbering and tall brick chimneys; dry-stone basalt walls; carved Maori pou, tomokanga gateways and koru motifs on public buildings.

sources.what: timber early buildings, corrugated iron replacing shingles, Marseilles tile 1890s-1920s, Californian bungalow with verandah, concrete and glass International style from the 1950s-60s
